items.text: I saw that the temperature would never make sense for me as I don't use Celsius or Kelvin, and the game only crashes trying to go past the main menu. Maybe I'll get it again sometime in the future, but right now it's not worth $0.01USD
items.text_zh: 我发现温度对我来说永远说不通，因为我不使用摄氏度或开尔文，而且游戏只在试图越过主菜单时崩溃。也许将来某个时候我会再买它，但现在它连0.01美元都不值
